title: Count Vowels
question: Count the vowels a, e, i, o, and u in a line of text.
code:
text = input("Text: ").lower()
count = sum(1 for char in text if char in "aeiou")
print("Vowels:", count)
expected_output:
For input Education:
Text: Education
Vowels: 5
explanation: Lowercasing lets one set of vowel characters match uppercase and lowercase input.
